This is the hand-authored MEANING half of an auto-derive-then-curate instrument: stages (the data-flow reading order), and the load-bearing units mapped to them with a plain-language role + substrate tag. render/derive_machinery.py reads this, AST-grounds every unit in the real code (signature, line, docstring, call edges), and cross-checks for drift. Edit this when the pipeline's SHAPE changes; re-run the derive when the CODE changes. scope_files are the 3 substrate seams the derive scans for 'uncovered' drift — public functions there that no unit covers (cost_surfaces.py re-export wrappers are expected to surface here).

stages.title: Truth & trajectory load
stages.purpose: Load the observed light curve, truth (q0, ω), cached forward-model outputs, and static geometry/BRDF/inertia for a seed.
stages.consumes: seed id; cached NPZ trajectories; STL/BRDF/tier config
stages.produces: truth dict (q0, ω0, times, mag, k1/k2_body, obs_dist, phase); static normals, inertia, tier table; render context

stages.title: Forward propagate
stages.purpose: Propagate (q0, ω) to attitude q(t) under conv-(a) and project sun/observer geometry into the body frame at each epoch.
stages.consumes: q0, ω0, times, inertia, J2000 sun/obs/sat positions
stages.produces: q(t), ω(t), body-frame k1/k2 geometry, observer distances, attitude matrices

stages.title: Cloud generate & anchor select
stages.purpose: Sample uniform SO(3) (q,ω) candidate clouds, project into the body frame per epoch, and select anchors by geodesic distance to truth.
stages.consumes: n_samples, sample seed; J2000 positions; truth quaternion(s)
stages.produces: candidate pool; per-candidate body-frame directions; nearest-pool anchor indices + geodesic distances

stages.title: Surrogate magnitude eval
stages.purpose: Map body-frame (k1,k2) geometry + articulation + observer distance to per-epoch apparent magnitude via the learned ensemble — fast.
stages.produces: per-epoch predicted magnitude; per-candidate survival masks vs measured mag

stages.title: Score & ρ-band classify
stages.purpose: Compute surrogate-MSE / NLL residuals and filter (alignment/geo) costs, then map to ρ and the A/B/C/D bands for ranking & acceptance.
stages.consumes: predicted vs target magnitude; candidate PAB/body geometry; bright-peak & spec-event indices
stages.produces: scalar residuals (full_lc_mse, bright_mse, nll_cost); filter costs [0,1]; ρ value; ρ-band label

stages.title: Solve & polish (BVP + LM)
stages.purpose: Solve the two-point attitude BVP via a finite-diff init then Levenberg-Marquardt polish of (q0, ω), single- and multi-anchor.
stages.consumes: (q_a, q_b, dt), inertia, ω init, optional anchors/base residual
stages.produces: polished ω_a / (q_a, ω), geodesic floor + connectability signal

stages.title: Hi-fi physical render
stages.purpose: Full ray-traced light curve via shadow ray-tracing (trimesh), Ashikhmin-Shirley BRDF, and per-facet flux integration to magnitude.
stages.consumes: q0, ω0, render context (geometry, mesh, BRDF, inertia); body-frame k1/k2; lit-status masks
stages.produces: hi-fi light curve (mag vs epoch); per-facet lit-status; per-facet flux

stages.title: Body-twin dedup
stages.purpose: Canonicalise (q0, ω) into the body-twin hemisphere and deduplicate 2× candidates to N via the body-X 180° twin map.
stages.produces: canonical-hemisphere sign-normalised representatives; deduped candidate set

stages.title: Compare & extract features
stages.purpose: Overlay/compare light curves with residual panels and extract fixed-length LC feature vectors + |ω| brackets.
stages.consumes: reference + comparison LC arrays; (t, mag) light curve
stages.produces: comparison/residual plot; (28,) LC feature vector; geomspace |ω| bracket prior

units.name: load_truth
units.role: Load cached NPZ trajectory: truth (q0, ω0) and forward-model outputs (k1_body, k2_body, mag_hifi, mag_lofi).

units.name: truth_state
units.role: Compact accessor for the most-used truth fields (q0, ω0, times, mag, k1/k2_body, obs_dist, phase_angle).

units.name: build_context
units.role: Load per-seed observation geometry (cached SPICE), STL + BRDF + inertia, and articulation matrices into a render context dict.

units.name: resolve_lc
units.role: Resolve an LC spec (traj:/npy:/npz:/state:) to a 1-D magnitude array; gated loader.

units.name: propagate_attitude
units.role: Unified dispatcher: routes (q0, ω, t) to the closed-form principal-axis or ODE Euler path by the mode flag. The canonical entry point.

units.name: propagate_principal_axis
units.role: Closed-form constant-ω attitude via the quaternion exponential (LEFT-multiply, conv-(a)).

units.name: propagate_euler
units.role: DOP853 ODE propagation of the torque-free Euler equations + quaternion kinematics for a tumbling body.

units.name: omega_jacobi
units.role: Closed-form body-frame ω(t) via Jacobi elliptic functions over the principal-axis polhode.

units.name: propagate_jacobi
units.role: Hybrid: closed-form ω(t) + DOP853 integration of the q-ODE; matches propagate_euler exactly.

units.name: propagate_jacobi_path2
units.role: Fully closed-form q(t) via 3-1-3 precession+nutation decomposition with Carlson elliptic integrals; the propagator the LM shoot solvers call.

units.name: _build_omega_func
units.role: Factory for the regime-dependent closed-form ω(t) in the principal-axis frame using sn/cn/dn.

units.name: _phi_closed_form_elliprj
units.role: Closed-form precession angle φ(t) via the incomplete elliptic integral of the third kind (Carlson R_F + R_J).

units.name: _eigendecompose_inertia
units.role: Eigendecomposition of the inertia tensor: principal moments (ascending) + rotation to the principal-axis frame.

units.name: _quat_from_matrix
units.role: Rotation matrix → scalar-first quaternion via Shepperd's stable method.

units.name: _quat_to_matrix
units.role: Scalar-first quaternion → 3×3 passive J2000→body rotation matrix (conv-(a)).

units.name: compute_observation_geometry
units.role: Observation geometry via SPICE: sun/observer body-frame vectors (k1,k2), distances, and attitude matrices per epoch.

units.name: propagate_to_body_frame
units.role: Forward glue: propagate (q0, ω0) and project the sun/observer vectors into the body frame per epoch (the propagator→geometry bridge).

units.name: propagate_candidate
units.role: Propagate (q0, ω) to body-frame sun/observer directions and the PAB vector via propagate_attitude.

units.name: sample_so3_pool
units.role: Generate n uniform Haar-measure SO(3) samples as rotation matrices + quaternions + rotation vectors.

units.name: compute_j2000_units
units.role: Convert J2000 positions to per-epoch unit vectors (sun, observer) — the inertial lighting geometry.

units.name: project_directions
units.role: Rotate the inertial sun/observer unit vectors into the body frame for all N pool candidates via cached rotation matrices.

units.name: nearest_in_pool_to_truth
units.role: Find the pool quaternion nearest a single truth quaternion (antipodal-aware): geodesic distance + index.

units.name: nearest_in_pool_to_truths
units.role: Batched anchor selection: closest pool index + geodesic distance for each per-epoch truth quaternion.

units.name: predict
units.role: The gated seam: body-frame (k1,k2) + articulation + obs distance → per-epoch apparent magnitude via the ensemble surrogate.

units.name: get_model
units.role: Lazy loader caching the default SurrogateModel singleton on first call (backs predict).

units.name: survive_at_epoch
units.role: Surrogate-magnitude survival mask: |pred − measured| < tolerance over the candidate cloud.

units.name: full_lc_mse
units.role: Core MSE metric: masked mean of (pred − target)² over all finite epochs. The primary optimisation residual.

units.name: bright_mse
units.role: Bright-subset MSE: masked mean where target < threshold (weights the glint epochs).

units.name: rho
units.role: Surrogate-space ρ metric: √MSE / 0.05 for ranking fit quality vs the noise floor.

units.name: nll_residual
units.role: RF25 Eq.3 per-epoch residual vector in flux space with optional signal rescaling (absorbs albedo/scale).

units.name: nll_cost
units.role: Scalar mean negative-log-likelihood (RF25 Eq.3) combining χ² data-fit and the per-epoch noise model.

units.name: surrogate_full_lc_mse
units.role: The scorer-facing primary residual — re-exports surrogate_eval.full_lc_mse (the LM objective).

units.name: surrogate_bright_mse
units.role: Re-export of bright_mse: MSE over the bright subset of the target LC only.

units.name: surrogate_nll_residual
units.role: Re-export of nll_residual: the RF25 Eq.3 NLL residual vector (flux space).

units.name: surrogate_nll_cost
units.role: Re-export of nll_cost: scalar mean NLL for ranking candidates (RF25 Eq.3).

units.name: precompute_seed_filter_data
units.role: Preprocess the truth LC into bright peaks + spec-event indices with tier labels and J2000 PAB/sun/obs vectors for the filter costs.

units.name: alignment_cost
units.role: Filter cost [0,1]: fraction of truth bright peaks matched by a candidate LC local minimum within ±window and below threshold.

units.name: geo_cost
units.role: Filter cost [0,1]: fraction of truth spec events where a tier-allowed face is within the angular threshold of the body-frame PAB.

units.name: evaluate_candidate
units.role: Orchestrator: propagate attitude, evaluate the surrogate, then score the alignment + geo filter costs.

units.name: rho_from_hifi
units.role: Final acceptance score: ρ = RMSE(pred, truth) / canonical noise σ (0.05) over the hi-fi light curve.

units.name: rho_band
units.role: Map a ρ score to the A/B/C/D classification band; the acceptance bar is ρ < 4 (Band A ∪ B).

units.name: finite_diff_omega
units.role: Extract a constant-ω estimate from two body-frame quaternions (q_a, q_b, dt); the crude init for the LM polisher.

units.name: shoot
units.role: LM solver for the two-point BVP: (q_a, q_b, dt) → ω_a with a geodesic floor and a connectability signal.

units.name: shoot_multianchor_freebase
units.role: Over-determined LM with a floating base q_a, K≥2 anchors, optional brightness-isophote constraint; averages cloud noise.

units.name: shoot_multianchor
units.role: Over-determined LM for ω_a with K≥2 target quaternions; pins trajectory winding via intermediate anchors.

units.name: render_hifi
units.role: Entry point: render the hi-fi LC for (q0, ω) via propagate-to-body-frame + shadow ray-tracing + BRDF-integrated generation.

units.name: compute_shadows
units.role: Ray-traced shadow computation: builds the articulated shadow meshes and returns per-component per-facet lit-status arrays.

units.name: calculate_brdf
units.role: Scalar Ashikhmin-Shirley BRDF: ρ = ρ_diff + ρ_spec from the dot-products and material params (r_d, r_s, n_phong).

units.name: calculate_brdf_vectorized
units.role: Vectorized Ashikhmin-Shirley BRDF (~50-200×): broadcasts the dot-products + material arrays to per-facet ρ.

units.name: convert_flux_to_magnitude
units.role: Magnitude conversion: m = m0_sun + 5·log10(d) − 2.5·log10(flux), with a surrogate-mode variant.

units.name: generate_lightcurves
units.role: LC generation: per-epoch integrate per-facet BRDF × visibility × geometry, then convert flux to magnitude.

units.name: twin
units.role: Apply the body-X 180° twin map (q0, ω) → (q_180x ⊗ q0, R_180x · ω); bit-exact LC equivalence.

units.name: canonical
units.role: Return the canonical-hemisphere representative of {(q0,ω), twin(q0,ω)} with sign-normalised output; idempotent.

units.name: canonical_batch
units.role: Vectorised canonical mapping over (N,4)/(N,3) arrays; dedup 2×N candidates to N.

units.name: make_plot
units.role: Generate N+1 stacked panels: overlay the reference + N comparisons, then N residual subplots.

units.name: main
units.role: CLI entry: parse args, resolve the reference + N comparison LCs, invoke make_plot.

units.name: lc_features
units.role: Extract a fixed-length (28,) feature vector from an LC (Lomb-Scargle peaks, brightness stats, ACF, glints).

units.name: ls_bracket
units.role: Geomspace |ω| bracket from the Lomb-Scargle peaks; the 5-cell prior for grid-pivot anchor selection.
